body:
**Executive-desk re-triage ruling (Henry, 2026-07-16; enacting decision 0016 §6; recorded as desk decision 0017).**

**Kept open — deprioritized; this is ra-platform adoption work, not dotfiles-agents packaging.** Valid as the first skills-over-commands migration, but nothing pulls it today. Park until ra-platform's next substantial touch; the migrated plan on the executive desk preserves the parity checklist.

Closed via PR #210 (merged to dev; PRs into dev don't auto-close). planning-desk skill verified to already subsume both ra-platform commands (plan-issue.md == references/plan.md, issue-body.md == references/issue-body.md); added an Adoption + migrating off ad-hoc commands subsection documenting the retirement pattern (fold project-specific bindings into _meta/plans/_config.md, then delete the commands). exec-desk bundle bumped 0.1.0 -> 0.2.0 in plugins.yaml (not primitives-core.yaml — that file's version: field is the roster schema version, not a per-bundle version; judgment call verified correct).

ra-platform's own adoption is staged as an UNCOMMITTED working-tree diff in that separate repo (~/Developer/ra-platform) — deletes .claude/commands/{plan-issue,issue-body}.md, adds _meta/plans/_config.md with the folded bindings, enables exec-desk@dotfiles-agents in .claude/settings.json. Nothing was committed or pushed there; that repo has its own governance and is not covered by this run's dev-only merge authority. Henry reviews and commits it himself, and runs a live-session smoke test to confirm the skill actually surfaces (a sibling repo has an open question about enabled-plugin-tools not always surfacing live, so this needs a real check, not just the toggle).
